title: tinyexr: Bound uncompressed HALF->HALF scanline copy against data_len
body:
## Summary

In `thirdparty/tinyexr/tinyexr.h`, `tinyexr::DecodePixelData()` (`lines 5591-5710`) decodes uncompressed scanline pixel data (`compression_type == TINYEXR_COMPRESSIONTYPE_NONE`) across four pixel-type sub-branches. Three of the four sub-branches verify that reading `width` elements from `line_ptr` does not exceed `data_ptr + data_len`:

- **`HALF -> FLOAT`** (`thirdparty/tinyexr/tinyexr.h:5629-5633`):
  ```cpp
  if (reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char *>(line_ptr + width) >
      (data_ptr + data_len)) {
    // Insufficient data size
    return false;
  }
  ```
- **`FLOAT -> FLOAT`** (`thirdparty/tinyexr/tinyexr.h:5664-5668`): checks `reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char *>(line_ptr + width) > (data_ptr + data_len)`.
- **`UINT -> UINT`** (`thirdparty/tinyexr/tinyexr.h:5692-5696`): checks `reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char *>(line_ptr + width) > (data_ptr + data_len)`.

However, the first sub-branch — **`HALF -> HALF`** (`channels[c].pixel_type == TINYEXR_PIXELTYPE_HALF && requested_pixel_types[c] == TINYEXR_PIXELTYPE_HALF`, `thirdparty/tinyexr/tinyexr.h:5600-5619`) — omits this check and immediately loops `for (int u = 0; u < width; u++)` calling `tinyexr::cpy2(&(hf.u), line_ptr + u)` (`line 5614`). Because `DecodeChunk` only checks that a scanline chunk's declared `data_len` fits within the remaining input buffer without requiring `data_len >= width * pixel_data_size`, a truncated or malformed uncompressed `HALF` scanline chunk with `data_len < width * sizeof(uint16_t)` causes `LoadEXRImageFromMemory` / `LoadEXRImageFromFile` (which default `requested_pixel_types[c]` to `TINYEXR_PIXELTYPE_HALF`) to read past `data_ptr + data_len` (heap-based buffer over-read, `CWE-125`).

## Impact on Godot

- Similar to `GH-124638` (`3e7eda1f0838c0ac5ce6eac023dbb0df8c40d10b`), Godot's `ImageLoaderTinyEXR::load_image` (`modules/tinyexr/image_loader_tinyexr.cpp:74-80`, `GH-13490`) sets `exr_header.requested_pixel_types[i] = TINYEXR_PIXELTYPE_FLOAT` for `TINYEXR_PIXELTYPE_HALF` channels (taking the guarded `HALF -> FLOAT` branch at line `5629` before converting back to `FORMAT_RH`/`RGH`/`RGBH`/`RGBAH` via `Math::make_half_float`), while `thirdparty/tinyexr/tinyexr.cc` compiles the full `TINYEXR_IMPLEMENTATION` (`LoadEXRImageFromMemory` / `LoadEXRImageFromFile`) with the unguarded `HALF -> HALF` loop in `DecodePixelData`.
- This PR adds the matching `reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char *>(line_ptr + width) > (data_ptr + data_len)` guard to the `HALF -> HALF` sub-branch (`thirdparty/tinyexr/tinyexr.h:5610`). (If desired, we can also add a corresponding `thirdparty/tinyexr/patches/0003-fix-uncompressed-half-scanline-bounds.patch` file and `thirdparty/README.md` entry referencing this PR number.)

## Testing

- Verified with `SaveEXRImageToMemory` -> `LoadEXRImageFromMemory` native-`HALF` (`TINYEXR_COMPRESSIONTYPE_NONE`) round-trips and truncated-chunk inputs under both Release (`-O3 -DNDEBUG`) and AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer (`-fsanitize=address,undefined`).

---
*Note: This patch was prepared with AI assistance and verified by human review and local test execution.*
